lines: RAZOR: EIGHTY-EIGHT POINT ONE, THE CHROME SKULL! RAZOR ON THE MIC, AND IF YOUR SPEAKERS AIN'T RATTLIN', YOU'RE DOIN' IT WRONG.
RAZOR: THAT ONE WAS LOUD ENOUGH TO SHAKE THE RUST OFF A TAILGATE. KEEP YOUR FOOT DOWN, WE GOT MORE COMIN'.
RAZOR: SOMEBODY OUT THERE JUST BLEW A TIRE ON THE EAST HIGHWAY. I HEARD IT FROM HERE. RAZOR SALUTES YOU, BROTHER.
RAZOR: CHROME SKULL RADIO. HARD ROCK FROM THE BONE PILE. NO REQUESTS, NO REFUNDS, NO MERCY.
RAZOR: ENGINE HOT? GOOD. CRANK IT UP, ROLL THE WINDOWS DOWN, AND LET THE DUST IN. THIS IS RAZOR.
RAZOR: IF YOU CAN HEAR THIS, YOU'RE STILL ALIVE. THAT'S WORTH A RIFF. HERE WE GO.
COPPER: EVENIN', ROAD PEOPLE. COPPER HERE ON RUST AND CHROME, NINETY-ONE POINT FOUR. SLIDE ON IN.
COPPER: THAT OLD SONG'S OLDER THAN THE HIGHWAY IT'S PLAYIN' ON. STILL RUNS, THOUGH. LIKE MY TRUCK.
COPPER: MOTEL SIGN UP BY THE SALT FLATS IS FLICKERIN' AGAIN. SOMEBODY'S GOT A GENERATOR RUNNIN'. SAY HI FOR ME.
COPPER: CLASSIC ROCK THAT OUTLIVED THE MAP. YOU'RE ON RUST AND CHROME. KEEP 'ER BETWEEN THE DITCHES.
COPPER: FILL YOUR RADIATOR BEFORE YOU CROSS THE FLATS, FRIENDS. COPPER'S SEEN TOO MANY STEAM CLOUDS THIS WEEK.
COPPER: LONG NIGHT, OPEN ROAD, AND ONE MORE FOR THE DRIVE. THIS IS COPPER.
NIX: ASPHALT ANGELS! NINETY-FOUR POINT SEVEN! NIX ON THE MIC, FENCE IS DOWN AND THE METER IS SMASHED!
NIX: WE BROADCAST FROM AN OVERPASS. WE DO NOT TAKE REQUESTS. DEAL WITH IT.
NIX: THREE CHORDS, BALD TIRES, ZERO APOLOGIES. THAT'S THE ANGELS. NEXT ONE'S FASTER.
NIX: SOMEBODY ASKED IF WE'D PLAY SOMETHING SLOW. WE LAUGHED FOR AN HOUR. HERE'S ANOTHER BANGER.
NIX: IF THE RAIDERS COME KNOCKIN', TURN THIS UP. THEY HATE IT. WE LOVE IT.
NIX: NIX SAYS GO. SO GO, GO, GO, AND DON'T LOOK BACK!
CINDER: AFTERNOON, CHILDREN OF THE DUST. THIS IS CINDER, PREACHIN' FROM THE BARREL FIRE ON DUSTBOWL, NINETY-SEVEN POINT TWO.
CINDER: FIND SOME SHADE, POUR SOME WATER, AND LET THAT SLIDE GUITAR CARRY YOU TO THE NEXT TOWN.
CINDER: HEAT'S A HUNDRED AND SOMETHIN' OUT THERE. THE GOOD LORD MADE AIR CONDITIONING. USE IT IF YOU GOT IT.
CINDER: SOUTHERN ROCK FOR A COUNTY THAT ISN'T THERE ANYMORE. STILL FEELS LIKE HOME, DON'T IT.
CINDER: SAY A WORD FOR THE SPARE TIRE, FRIENDS. IT'S THE ONLY ONE RIDIN' WITH YOU THAT NEVER COMPLAINS.
CINDER: AMEN, AND TURN IT UP. CINDER ON DUSTBOWL.
LITA: HI HI HI, IT'S LITA ON MIKE'S MIX, ONE HUNDRED POINT THREE, TOP OF THE SCRAP!
LITA: THAT ONE'S BEEN NUMBER ONE AT THE HUB FOR SIX WEEKS, AND I'M NOT EVEN SICK OF IT YET.
LITA: SHOUT OUT TO EVERYBODY DANCING IN THE DUST TONIGHT. YES, YOU. I CAN TELL.
LITA: MIKE'S MIX, WHERE THE CHORUSES STILL WORK EVEN IF NOTHING ELSE DOES.
LITA: SATURDAY AT THE END OF THE WORLD, AND WE'VE GOT THE HITS. STAY PRETTY, WASTELAND.
LITA: COMING UP, MORE SONGS YOU'LL HUM WHILE YOU FIX YOUR CARBURETOR. LITA LOVES YOU.
PALMA: GOOD EVENING FROM THE LAST OASIS. THIS IS PALMA, ONE-OH-THREE POINT FIVE.
PALMA: THE FOUNTAIN IN THE ATRIUM HAS BEEN DRY FOR YEARS. TONIGHT, IT SOUNDS LIKE IT'S RUNNING AGAIN.
PALMA: PLASTIC PALMS, GATED DRUMS, AND ONE MORE LOVE SONG FOR THE WATER BAR.
PALMA: IF YOU'RE DRIVING ALONE TONIGHT, YOU'RE NOT. YOU'RE WITH ME.
PALMA: THE LOBBY IS CLOSING, BUT THE MUSIC NEVER DOES. LAST OASIS.
PALMA: PALMA, AFTER DUSK. STAY A WHILE.
VEGA: YOU'RE RIDING NEON DUNES, ONE-OH-FIVE POINT EIGHT. VEGA AT THE WHEEL. OUTRUN THE HEAT.
VEGA: SUN'S GOING DOWN, GRID'S COMING UP. HEADLIGHTS ON, HELMETS OFF.
VEGA: THAT STRIP ON THE HORIZON? IT'S A MIRAGE. DRIVE TOWARD IT ANYWAY.
VEGA: ANALOG BASS FOR DIGITAL GHOSTS. NEON DUNES.
VEGA: CHASE MUSIC FOR PEOPLE WHO NEVER GET CAUGHT. NEXT UP.
VEGA: VEGA SIGNING THE SKY. KEEP THE NEEDLE PAST THE RED.
SHADE: THIS IS SHADE. NIGHT DRIVE, ONE-OH-SEVEN POINT ONE. KEEP YOUR LOW BEAMS ON.
SHADE: THERE'S A SECOND PAIR OF HEADLIGHTS BEHIND YOU. DON'T LOOK. JUST DRIVE.
SHADE: RAIN ON THE WRECKS TONIGHT. THEY SOUND ALMOST ALIVE.
SHADE: STAY BETWEEN THE LINES. THE LINES ARE THE ONLY THING OUT HERE THAT STILL MEANS ANYTHING.
SHADE: IF YOUR ENGINE STALLS IN THE FOG, DO NOT GET OUT. I'LL KEEP YOU COMPANY.
SHADE: SHADE, AFTER MIDNIGHT. THE ROAD IS LONG, AND IT IS DARK.
GRID: SCRAPYARD. ONE-OH-SEVEN POINT SEVEN. GRID CLOCKED IN. GRID NEVER CLOCKS OUT.
GRID: THE PRESS LINE DOESN'T STOP. NEITHER DOES THE BEAT.
GRID: MAGNETIC CRANE IS SWINGING, CONVEYOR'S HUMMING, AND YOU ARE LOCKED IN.
GRID: INDUSTRIAL FREQUENCY. METAL ON METAL. SCRAPYARD.
GRID: NEXT LOOP STRAIGHT FROM THE CRUSHER. MIND YOUR FINGERS.
GRID: GRID. SHIFT ONE THOUSAND AND ONE. CONTINUE.
VEX: ACID BARRENS PIRATE STACK, ONE-OH-SEVEN POINT NINE! VEX IN THE PIT! DON'T TASTE THE AIR!
VEX: RESPIRATORS OPTIONAL. THREE OH THREE MANDATORY.
VEX: YELLOW SKY, GREEN PUDDLES, AND A KICK DRUM YOU FEEL IN YOUR FILLINGS.
VEX: IF YOUR GEIGER COUNTER'S CLICKING IN TIME WITH THE BEAT, YOU'RE IN THE RIGHT PLACE.
VEX: LAST CALL BEFORE THE GENERATORS DIE. MAKE IT COUNT, RAVERS.
VEX: VEX OUT. ACTUALLY NO. VEX NEVER OUT. NEXT ONE!
EARL: BUSTED AXLE? BENT FRAME? DOOR HANGIN' BY ONE HINGE?
EARL: COME ON DOWN TO MAD MIKE'S GARAGE! WE BOLT IT, WE WELD IT, WE BEAT IT WITH A HAMMER TILL IT LISTENS!
EARL: ANY PART, ANY CAR. IF IT FITS A SOCKET, IT FITS YOUR RIDE. MAD MIKE'S GARAGE. BUILD IT, BREAK IT, BOLT IT BACK TOGETHER.
HANK: FRIENDS, IS YOUR TANK RUNNIN' ON FUMES AND PRAYERS?
HANK: GUS'S GUZZOLINE DEPOT, RIGHT OFF THE OLD HIGHWAY! DIESEL, GASOLINE, AND A BIOFUEL SO FRESH YOU CAN SMELL THE CORN.
HANK: BRING YOUR OWN JERRY CAN, BRING YOUR OWN HOSE, AND PLEASE, BRING YOUR OWN MANNERS. GUS'S GUZZOLINE. WE NEVER RUN DRY. MOSTLY.
RUBY: BALD TIRES? BLOWOUTS? LOSIN' GRIP IN THE MUD?
RUBY: RUSTY'S TYRE BARN HAS KNOBBIES FOR THE SWAMP, SLICKS FOR THE SALT, AND TREADS SO DEEP YOU COULD LOSE A DOG IN 'EM.
RUBY: RUSTY'S TYRE BARN. WE'RE ON A ROLL.
DOLLY: WHEN THE WORLD ENDED, AUNT DEE KEPT CANNING.
DOLLY: BEANS, PEACHES, MYSTERY STEW, AND PICKLES OLDER THAN YOU ARE. AUNT DEE'S CANNED GOODS NEVER SPOIL. PROBABLY.
DOLLY: AUNT DEE'S. TASTE THE BEFORE TIMES.
WALT: LACERATION? FRACTURE? A BITE FROM SOMETHING YOU'D RATHER NOT DESCRIBE?
WALT: DOC HOLLOW'S CLINIC OFFERS BANDAGES, SPLINTS, DISINFECTANT, AND A GENUINE MEDICAL DEGREE, FOUND IN A DRAWER.
WALT: DOC HOLLOW. WE'LL PATCH YOU UP. SIDE EFFECTS MAY INCLUDE EVERYTHING.
RUBY: THIRSTY? OF COURSE YOU ARE. EVERYBODY'S THIRSTY.
RUBY: OASIS WATER COMPANY. FILTERED, BOILED, AND TESTED ON THE INTERN. PURE AS THE RAIN BEFORE IT HITS THE MUD.
RUBY: OASIS WATER. DRINK UP, DRY OUT LATER.
EARL: BULLSEYE AMMO AND OUTFITTERS. SHELLS, NAILS, BOLTS, AND A FRIENDLY WORD OF ADVICE: AIM.
EARL: TRADE IN YOUR SCRAP, WALK OUT ARMED. BULLSEYE. BECAUSE THE RAIDERS SURE SHOPPED SOMEWHERE.
HANK: YOU SEE A WRECK. WE SEE A TREASURE CHEST WITH WHEELS!
HANK: SCRAP AND BOLT SALVAGE PAYS TOP RATION FOR COPPER, IRON, GLASS, AND ANYTHING THAT USED TO HAVE A MOTOR.
HANK: BRING YOUR SALVAGE CUTTER AND YOUR APPETITE. SCRAP AND BOLT. ONE MAN'S WRECK IS ANOTHER MAN'S RETIREMENT.
DOLLY: TIRED OF SITTIN' IN THE DARK LISTENIN' TO THINGS SCRATCH AT YOUR WALLS?
DOLLY: SPARKY'S POWER AND LIGHT! GENERATORS, WIND TURBINES, BATTERY BANKS, AND CABLE BY THE MILE.
DOLLY: LIGHT UP THE NIGHT. SPARKY'S. NOW WITH FEWER FIRES!
GUS: THE GROUND REMEMBERS. GIVEN WATER AND A LITTLE PATIENCE, IT GIVES BACK.
GUS: GREENWAY SEED COOPERATIVE. CORN, POTATOES, SQUASH AND ELEVEN CROPS THAT DON'T MIND A LITTLE RADIATION.
GUS: PLANT SOMETHING. GREENWAY.
EARL: STUCK IN THE MUD UP TO YOUR DOOR HANDLES? DON'T CRY ABOUT IT. WINCH ABOUT IT!
EARL: HOOK-EM WINCH AND CRANE. HOOK A TREE, HOOK A ROCK, HOOK YOUR COUSIN'S TRUCK, AND PULL YOURSELF FREE.
EARL: HOOK-EM WINCH AND CRANE. GET YOURSELF UNSTUCK.
WALT: WASTELAND MUTUAL INSURANCE. FOR WHEN THINGS GO WRONG.
WALT: AND THEY WILL. EVERYTHING WILL GO WRONG. EVERY SINGLE THING.
WALT: WASTELAND MUTUAL. WE CAN'T HELP, BUT WE'LL LISTEN.
RUBY: YOUR WAR RIG DESERVES TO LOOK AS MEAN AS IT DRIVES!
RUBY: SKULL AND FLAME CUSTOM PAINT. FLAMES, STRIPES, SKULLS, AND MORE FLAMES. WE DON'T DO BEIGE.
RUBY: SKULL AND FLAME. LOOK FAST STANDING STILL.
HANK: AFTER A LONG DAY OF WRENCHIN' AND WRECKIN', THERE'S ONLY ONE PLACE TO GO.
HANK: THE RUSTY PISTON SALOON. COLD DRINKS, WARM COMPANY, AND A BOUNCER NAMED TINY WHO IS NOT TINY.
HANK: THE RUSTY PISTON. NO FIGHTIN' INSIDE. TAKE IT TO THE PARKING LOT.
GUS: A PUBLIC SERVICE MESSAGE FROM THE WASTELAND MOTORISTS' LEAGUE.
GUS: CHECK YOUR OIL. CHECK YOUR COOLANT. IF THE NEEDLE'S PAST ONE HUNDRED AND TEN, PULL OVER BEFORE YOUR ENGINE COOKS LIKE BREAKFAST.
GUS: THE MOTORISTS' LEAGUE. WE'D RATHER SEE YOU DRIVE THAN WALK.
DOLLY: RAIN'S COMIN', AND YOU KNOW WHAT THAT MEANS. MUD.
DOLLY: LOCK THAT DIFF, SWITCH TO FOUR WHEEL DRIVE, AND DON'T STOP SPINNIN' IN THE SOFT STUFF, OR YOU'LL DIG YOURSELF A GRAVE.
DOLLY: A FRIENDLY REMINDER FROM YOUR NEIGHBORS AT WASTETALK F M.
RUBY: WASTETALK F M, NINETY POINT ONE. TALK RADIO FOR THE END OF THE WORLD.
WALT: YOU'RE LISTENING TO WASTETALK, NINETY POINT ONE. STILL BROADCASTING. STILL TALKING.
HANK: WASTETALK, NINETY POINT ONE! IF IT HAPPENED, WE'RE TALKIN' ABOUT IT. IF IT DIDN'T, WE'RE MAKIN' IT UP!
DOLLY: NINETY POINT ONE, WASTETALK. THE VOICE OF THE WASTELAND, AND SOME OF ITS NEIGHBORS.
HANK: GOOD MORNIN', WASTELAND! THIS HERE'S BIG HANK ON WASTETALK F M, NINETY POINT ONE, AND IF YOU CAN HEAR ME, YOU AIN'T DEAD YET!
DOLLY: AND I'M DOLLY, AND HANK, IT IS WAY TOO EARLY FOR THAT MUCH YELLIN'.
HANK: DOLLY, IT'S NEVER TOO EARLY FOR ENTHUSIASM. I'VE HAD FOUR COFFEES. WELL, FOUR CUPS OF SOMETHIN' BROWN.
DOLLY: THAT WAS THE MOTOR OIL, HANK. WE TALKED ABOUT THIS.
HANK: TASTES ABOUT THE SAME, DARLIN'. ANYHOW, BIG SHOW TODAY, FOLKS. WE GOT THE NEWS, WE GOT WEATHER, AND WE GOT THE WRENCH LINE OPEN FOR YOUR CALLS.
DOLLY: SO STAY TUNED, KEEP YOUR TIRES FULL, AND YOUR POWDER DRY.
DOLLY: HANK, DID YOU SEE THE CONVOY THAT ROLLED THROUGH LAST NIGHT?
HANK: DID I SEE IT? DOLLY, I HEARD IT. SOUNDED LIKE A THUNDERSTORM MADE OF MUFFLERS.
DOLLY: SIX WAR RIGS, TWO TANKERS, AND ONE LITTLE TRABANT TRYIN' REAL HARD TO KEEP UP.
HANK: BLESS THAT TRABANT. THAT LITTLE TWO STROKE ENGINE'S GOT MORE HEART THAN THE WHOLE CONVOY.
DOLLY: IT ALSO HAD A GOAT IN THE PASSENGER SEAT.
HANK: WELL, A GOAT'S GOTTA GET PLACES TOO, DOLLY.
HANK: TIME FOR HANK'S HOT TIP OF THE MORNIN'!
HANK: IF YOUR ENGINE'S SMOKIN' WHITE, THAT'S COOLANT. IF IT'S SMOKIN' BLACK, THAT'S TOO MUCH FUEL. AND IF IT'S SMOKIN' BLUE, WELL, YOU'RE BURNIN' OIL, AND YOU BETTER TOP IT UP BEFORE SHE SEIZES.
DOLLY: AND IF IT'S SMOKING GREEN?
HANK: THEN DOLLY, YOU DROVE THROUGH THE ACID BARRENS AGAIN, AND I CAN'T HELP YOU.
DOLLY: WORDS TO LIVE BY.
DOLLY: HANK, A LISTENER WROTE IN. WELL, SCRATCHED IN. ON A HUBCAP.
HANK: READ IT, DOLLY.
DOLLY: IT SAYS, DEAR HANK AND DOLLY, MY HUSBAND SPENDS ALL DAY IN THE GARAGE BOLTING SPIKES ON THE CAR. SHOULD I BE WORRIED?
HANK: MA'AM, I'D BE WORRIED IF HE WASN'T. A CAR WITHOUT SPIKES IS JUST A TARGET WITH A RADIO.
DOLLY: SHE ALSO SAYS HE NAMED THE CAR AFTER HIS EX-WIFE.
HANK: OH. OKAY. NOW YOU CAN WORRY.
HANK: WELL FOLKS, THAT'S ABOUT ALL THE MORNIN' WE CAN HANDLE.
DOLLY: DRINK YOUR WATER, CHECK YOUR TIRES, AND BE NICE TO EACH OTHER OUT THERE.
HANK: AND IF YOU CAN'T BE NICE, BE QUICK! THIS HAS BEEN BIG HANK AND DOLLY IN THE MORNIN', ON WASTETALK F M!
EARL: YOU'RE ON THE WRENCH LINE WITH EARL, WHERE WE FIX YOUR PROBLEMS, OR AT LEAST TALK ABOUT 'EM. GO AHEAD, CALLER.
CALLER: HEY EARL, LONG TIME LISTENER. MY TRUCK PULLS TO THE LEFT REAL BAD EVER SINCE I HIT A WALL AT, UH, PRETTY FAST.
EARL: SON, THAT'S YOUR FRAME. YOU BENT IT. EVERY TIME YOU HIT SOMETHIN', THAT FRAME REMEMBERS.
CALLER: SO, UH, CAN I FIX IT, OR WHAT?
EARL: GET YOURSELF TO A GARAGE AND A REPAIR KIT. AND MAYBE STOP HITTIN' WALLS. NEXT CALLER.
EARL: WRENCH LINE, YOU'RE ON THE AIR.
CALLER: HI EARL. I'M STUCK IN THE MUD DOWN BY THE LAKE AND MY WHEELS JUST SPIN.
EARL: MA'AM, YOU ON THE RADIO IN THE CAR RIGHT NOW?
CALLER: YES. IT'S THE ONLY THING THAT STILL WORKS.

EARL: ALRIGHT. THAT OPEN DIFFERENTIAL IS SENDIN' ALL YOUR POWER TO THE WHEEL WITH NO GRIP. LOCK THE DIFF IF YOU GOT ONE. FOUR WHEEL DRIVE IF YOU GOT THAT. AND IF YOU GOT A WINCH, HOOK THE NEAREST TREE.
CALLER: THERE'S NO TREE. THERE'S A VERY LARGE DEAD COW.
EARL: THEN HOOK THE COW, MA'AM. THE COW WON'T MIND.
EARL: WRENCH LINE, GO AHEAD.
CALLER: EARL! EARL! MY ENGINE JUST STOPPED AND THERE'S STEAM COMIN' OUT EVERYWHERE!
EARL: CALM DOWN, FRIEND. WHEN DID YOU LAST PUT COOLANT IN IT?
CALLER: PUT WHAT IN IT?
EARL: THERE IT IS. LET IT COOL, TOP UP THE COOLANT, AND PRAY YOUR HEAD GASKET'S STILL IN ONE PIECE. NEXT CALLER.
EARL: WRENCH LINE. YOU'RE ON.
CALLER: EARL, I FOUND A WHOLE ENGINE OUT IN A WRECK BY THE HIGHWAY. HOW DO I GET IT OUT?
EARL: YOU BRING A WRENCH, YOU WALK UP TO IT, AND YOU TAKE IT. THAT'S SALVAGE, MY FRIEND. FINDERS KEEPERS OUT HERE.
CALLER: WHAT IF THE OWNER COMES BACK?
EARL: THEN YOU RUN FASTER THAN THE OWNER. THANKS FOR CALLIN'. THIS IS THE WRENCH LINE ON WASTETALK.
WALT: THIS IS THE WASTELAND WIRE. I'M WALT.
WALT: RAIDERS WERE SPOTTED NEAR THE OLD REFINERY LATE LAST NIGHT. WITNESSES REPORT SPIKED BUMPERS, LOUD MUSIC, AND VERY POOR MANNERS.
WALT: RESIDENTS ARE ADVISED TO LOCK THEIR DOORS, HIDE THEIR FUEL, AND NOT ANSWER IF SOMEONE KNOCKS WITH A CROWBAR.
WALT: IN OTHER NEWS, THE SCRAPYARD CRUSHER IS RUNNING AGAIN AFTER THREE WEEKS OF REPAIRS. THE CRUSHER'S OPERATOR DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS, QUOTE, THRILLED, AND SLIGHTLY DEAF.
WALT: THE WASTELAND WIRE. TOP STORY.
WALT: A TANKER TRAILER CARRYING TWO THOUSAND LITRES OF FUEL WAS FOUND ABANDONED ON THE SOUTH ROAD THIS MORNING. BY NOON, THE FUEL WAS ALSO ABANDONED. BY ONE O'CLOCK, IT WAS GONE.
WALT: AUTHORITIES, SUCH AS THEY ARE, HAVE NO SUSPECTS. EVERYONE WITHIN FIFTY KILOMETRES HAS A FULL TANK.
WALT: WATER PRICES ARE STABLE AT THE LAST OASIS. TOMATO PRICES ARE NOT. DETAILS AS WE GET THEM.
WALT: THIS IS THE WASTELAND WIRE.
WALT: THE TOWN COUNCIL OF WHAT USED TO BE THE TOWN MET YESTERDAY TO DISCUSS THE POTHOLE ON MAIN STREET.
WALT: THE POTHOLE IS NOW ELEVEN METRES DEEP AND HAS ITS OWN ECOSYSTEM. THE COUNCIL VOTED TO NAME IT RATHER THAN FILL IT.
WALT: IN SPORTS, THE SATURDAY DEMOLITION DERBY WAS WON BY A HAULER WITH A WALK-IN MODULE, WHICH SOME COMPETITORS CALLED, QUOTE, BASICALLY A HOUSE.
WALT: THE WASTELAND WIRE, EVENING EDITION.
WALT: A FOREST FIRE IN THE NORTHERN WOODS HAS BEEN BURNING FOR THREE DAYS. SMOKE IS DRIFTING SOUTH WITH THE WIND. KEEP YOUR WINDOWS CLOSED AND YOUR WATER BARRELS FULL.
WALT: FARMERS REPORT AN EXCELLENT POTATO HARVEST, AND AN ALARMING NUMBER OF POTATOES WITH FACES. EXPERTS SAY THEY ARE SAFE TO EAT. EXPERTS ARE NOT EATING THEM.
WALT: THAT'S THE WIRE. I'M WALT. GOOD NIGHT, AND GOOD LUCK.
RUBY: WEATHER TIME WITH RUBY! IT'S HOT, IT'S DRY, AND THE SUN IS OUT TO GET YOU.
RUBY: ROADS ARE HARD AND FAST TODAY, PERFECT FOR SPEEDING, NOT SO PERFECT FOR YOUR RADIATOR. KEEP AN EYE ON THAT TEMPERATURE NEEDLE.
RUBY: AND WEAR A HAT. SKIN IS NOT A RENEWABLE RESOURCE.
RUBY: RUBY WITH THE WEATHER, AND FOLKS, IT'S RAINING! ACTUAL WATER, FALLING FROM THE ACTUAL SKY!
RUBY: SET OUT YOUR RAIN COLLECTORS AND FILL EVERY BUCKET YOU OWN. BUT REMEMBER, THE DIRT ROADS WILL TURN TO SOUP FAST. STICK TO THE HIGHWAY IF YOU CAN.
RUBY: MUD'S DEEP, RUTS ARE DEEPER. DRIVE SMART, AND WATCH THE LAKE SHORES. THEY'RE RISING.
RUBY: RUBY HERE, AND WOULD YOU LOOK AT THAT. SNOW! IN THE WASTELAND!
RUBY: BUNDLE UP IN LAYERS, KEEP THE STOVE BURNING, AND WATCH OUT FOR ICE ON THE ROADS. YOUR TIRES WILL NOT THANK YOU FOR THE SURPRISE.
RUBY: WET CLOTHES KILL FASTER THAN RAIDERS OUT THERE, SO GET DRY AND STAY WARM.
RUBY: WEATHER FOR TONIGHT. CLEAR SKIES, A COLD WIND, AND TEMPERATURES DROPPING FAST AFTER SUNDOWN.
RUBY: TURN ON YOUR HEADLIGHTS, BRING A BLANKET, AND MAYBE DON'T DRIVE PAST THE OLD CEMETERY. JUST A SUGGESTION.
RUBY: THAT'S YOUR WEATHER. I'M RUBY, AND I'M GOING BACK TO BED.
GUS: GOOD EVENING. THIS IS THE GRAVEYARD SHIFT, AND I'M GUS.
GUS: IT'S LATE. THE GENERATORS ARE HUMMING, THE DOGS HAVE STOPPED BARKING, AND SOMEWHERE OUT THERE, A LONE DRIVER IS LISTENING.
GUS: I WANT YOU TO KNOW SOMETHING, DRIVER. THE ROAD AHEAD IS DARK. BUT EVERY ROAD ENDS SOMEWHERE. AND SOMEWHERE, THERE'S A LIGHT ON.
GUS: STAY WITH ME A WHILE.
GUS: I USED TO DRIVE TRUCKS, BEFORE. LONG HAULS. COAST TO COAST.
GUS: BACK THEN, THE RADIO WAS FULL OF VOICES. BALL GAMES, PREACHERS, PEOPLE SELLING KITCHEN KNIVES AT THREE IN THE MORNING.
GUS: NOW THERE'S JUST A HANDFUL OF US. BUT WE'RE STILL HERE. AND SO ARE YOU.
GUS: THAT'S ENOUGH, ISN'T IT. THAT'S ENOUGH.
GUS: A LISTENER ASKED ME ONCE WHAT I MISS MOST ABOUT THE OLD WORLD.
GUS: I THOUGHT ABOUT IT A LONG TIME. ICE CREAM. TRAFFIC LIGHTS. THE SMELL OF RAIN ON HOT PAVEMENT.
GUS: WELL, WE STILL HAVE THAT LAST ONE. SO TONIGHT, IF IT RAINS, ROLL YOUR WINDOW DOWN. JUST FOR A MINUTE.
GUS: THIS HAS BEEN THE GRAVEYARD SHIFT. GOOD NIGHT, WASTELAND.
DOLLY: WELCOME TO DIRT TALK, THE GARDENING HOUR, WHERE WE TALK ABOUT DIRT. I'M DOLLY.
DOLLY: THIS WEEK, POTATOES. THEY GROW IN NEAR ABOUT ANYTHING, THEY KEEP FOR AGES, AND YOU CAN MAKE THEM INTO FUEL IF YOU'RE DESPERATE.
DOLLY: PLANT 'EM IN A PLOT OR A PLANTER, KEEP THE WATER COMIN', AND A LITTLE FERTILIZER NEVER HURT ANYBODY. WELL. ALMOST ANYBODY.
DOLLY: AND PLEASE, IF A POTATO LOOKS BACK AT YOU, LEAVE IT BE.
DOLLY: DIRT TALK, BACK AGAIN. A CALLER ASKED ABOUT FRUIT TREES.
DOLLY: FRUIT TREES TAKE PATIENCE, HONEY. A SEASON OR TWO. BUT AN APPLE OFF YOUR OWN TREE AT THE END OF THE WORLD TASTES LIKE VICTORY.
DOLLY: SPRINKLERS HELP IF YOU'VE GOT A WATER TANK AND SOME PIPE. THE SEASONS MATTER, TOO. DON'T PLANT IN THE FROST.
DOLLY: THAT'S DIRT TALK. GO GET YOUR HANDS DIRTY.
